headline: Instagram adds Amazon affiliate links to Reels and feed posts
summary: Instagram now lets creators add Amazon affiliate links directly within Reels and feed posts, rather than only through stories, DMs, or bios as before. One outlet reports creators can attach up to 30 affiliate links per Reel. Coverage also notes that some content creators are suspicious of the new affiliate program.
